decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
The proposed single storey front/side extension, two storey side extension, part single-storey part two-storey rear extension and single storey rear extension by reason of their bulk, size, scale and proportion, would create an obtrusive feature harmful to the appearance of this building and the pair of semi detached dwellings of which it forms part and of the area as a whole contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1  (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines (REG 2002).

Given its size and bulk in close proximity to the neighbouring properties, the development would be visually obtrusive and would harm the living conditions at the adjoining properties through loss of outlook and an overbearing appearance, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1  (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow UDP and the Residential Extension Guidelines (REG 2002).
description: Erection of 2 storey side extension, part two storey rear extension, part single storey rear extension, part single storey side/ front extension and single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
